entry.title: Explore the World's Largest Collection of Poisonous Plants | Guinness World Records

media:group.media:title: Explore the World's Largest Collection of Poisonous Plants | Guinness World Records
media:group.media:description:
Breaking the record for the most species of poisonous plants in a single garden, this collection comes with a simple rule: no touching, no picking, no tasting and no smelling. These plants are dangerous, and adjudicator Will Munford is brave enough to go on a guided tour in Alnwick, Northumberland. Every plant has a story to tell and his trusty guides are ready to give him the low-down. And you can read even more about it in Guinness World Records 2027.

entry.title: Most municipalities to co-ordinate the same environmental awareness walk simultaneously - 34 🇻🇳

media:group.media:title: Most municipalities to co-ordinate the same environmental awareness walk simultaneously - 34 🇻🇳
media:group.media:description:
Congratulations to Nhan Dan Newspaper for achieving the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for most municipalities to co-ordinate the same environmental awareness walk simultaneously - 34 🇻🇳
In its second year, the programme brought communities together at 34 main event locations across Vietnam, alongside local walks in more than 3,000 communes, wards and special zones.
Together, participants championed walking as a daily habit to help reduce CO₂ emissions and inspire action towards a zero-waste future. The campaign was jointly organised by Nhan Dan Newspaper, the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Public Security and the Ho Chi Minh Communist Youth Union Central Committee.
Special thanks to Vietcombank, Petrolimex, TH Group and Vietnamobile for their valuable support in making this nationwide campaign a success.
